statements.text: A 6-seat design agency on a trial asked support twice in October 2026 to keep its sample project as a template.
3 of 12 interviewed trial teams rebuilt a previous project by hand in their first session.
Sales believes trial teams are interested in a template gallery.
A starter-template button on the empty workspace could ship in under a week from the existing sample-data fixtures.
How a trial user starts a first project without help has not been observed.
statements.resolution: Watch five new trial users start a first project without help and note what surprises.

questions.text: Has anyone on the team watched a new trial user try to start a first project without help? What did they do that surprised you?

next_action.action: Add the template-button click event and run the fake-door test on half of new trials for 14 days.

idea: Starter templates on the empty trial workspace so new teams reach a first project sooner.

covered_by.text: 14 of 40 reviewed trial support chats asked how to start a first project

premises.text: New trial teams stall because the empty workspace gives them nothing to start from.
The existing sample-data fixtures can become templates without design work.
Templates ship inside the existing web app; no new distribution channel is needed.

alternatives.name: Fake-door template button
alternatives.summary: Show a starter-template button on the empty workspace that logs clicks and offers the existing sample project.

alternatives.name: Template library
alternatives.summary: A versioned template library with three designed starter projects and a picker on the empty workspace.
pros: Teams can add their own templates later
cons: Weeks of design and build before any signal

alternatives.name: Spreadsheet import
alternatives.summary: Let a new team create its first project from a spreadsheet it already keeps.
pros: Matches teams that rebuild projects by hand
cons: Does not help teams with nothing to import

recommendation.reason: It tests whether teams want a starting point before any template design work, which the requester said the fixtures need.

decisions.question: Which approach should go into the lean PRD?
decisions.why: Cheapest way to learn whether teams want a starting point.

success_criteria.metric: Share of new trials that click the starter-template button
success_criteria.window: first 14 days of the fake-door test

handoff.notes: After the approach decision, a lean PRD for the chosen approach; the fake-door needs no engineering beyond one event and one button.
